verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Skyvern serves a live llms.txt at skyvern.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a descriptive product summary), and there is an agent-oriented /llms page. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 document at api.skyvern.com/openapi.json also gives agents structured docs to consume. Missing for 10: markdown versions of doc pages (docs.md returns 404), evidence of an llms-full.txt or how comprehensive the llms.txt content is, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
